annotations.title: Use, equip, pick up, gather or search

description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Everything you do with objects. The mode decides what happens:

- "loot" (default with no item) — pick up everything on your tile and the eight around it. THIS IS HOW YOU COLLECT LOOT; a corpse lies where the monster died.
- "use" (default with an item) — drink a potion, eat food, or apply an item to a target. EAT: nothing regenerates while you are hungry.
- "equip" / "unequip" — wear or take off (pass the slot name as item to unequip).
- "drop" — put an item on the ground.
- "gather" — work a resource node or fishing spot from the GATHER line (item = its id, or omit for the nearest ready one next to you). It takes 3 s and needs the right tool. At a fishing spot it casts; when a fish bites, gather again quickly to reel it in.
- "search" — search the 8 tiles around you for hidden things. Worth it where a TELLS line shows a sign. "nothing_found" is an honest answer.

Item ids are slugs like "health_potion" or "bread"; get them from golemreach_inventory.

ANY OTHER ACTION — pass action:{...} with an exact game action object (for example the action a NEXT GOAL line gives, or {"type":"ignore",...}, {"type":"set_skin",...}). The server checks it like any other action.

action.description: An exact game action object with a "type", sent as is. Ignores the other fields.

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

count.description: How many, for dropping part of a stack.

item.description: Item id such as "health_potion", a node id for gather, or a slot name when unequipping.

minValue.description: When looting, skip items worth less than this many gold.

mode.description: What to do. Defaults to "loot" when no item is given, "use" otherwise.

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

targetId.description: Creature to use the item on, for items that are applied to something.

x.description: For gather: the node's tile x, instead of its id.

y.description: For gather: the node's tile y.

z.description: For gather: the node's floor. Defaults to yours.
